title: release: add artifact signing, SBOM and provenance manifests for private-installer releases
author: Sarah Patel
description:
Motivation: ensure Private Installer release artifacts are reproducible, signed, and accompanied by provenance and SBOMs so downstream customers can verify integrity and supply-chain metadata. This PR implements deterministic artifact packaging for helm charts and terraform modules, generates SBOMs (syft), attests build provenance (in-toto/cosign), signs release artifacts with Cosign, and emits a machine-readable release manifest used by the release automation pipeline and private-installer upgrade tooling.

What changed (summary):
- New CI workflow: .github/workflows/release-provenance.yml which builds artifacts in a hermetic environment, runs syft to produce SBOMs, records in-toto provenance, and invokes cosign to sign artifacts and attestations.
- Release manifests: scripts/release/generate-release-manifest.py (packaging metadata for each artifact: digest, signature, sbom_url, provenance_url).
- Helm changes: charts/private-installer/Chart.yaml bumped; packaging step ensured deterministic ordering and reproducible timestamps.
- Terraform: modules/terraform/packaging -> produces gzipped tarballs with fixed mtime and canonical file ordering.
- CI helpers: Makefile targets (make release-pack, make sbom, make sign) and Dockerfile.reproducible for build image.
- Docs: docs/release/PROVENANCE.md describing how to verify signatures and provenance, and ops runbook for private deployments.
- Tests: integration test that validates manifest->artifact signature chain and SBOM presence.

Checklist: 
- [x] deterministic packaging for helm and terraform artifacts
- [x] SBOM generation via syft (.spdx.json and .cyclonedx.json outputs)
- [x] provenance attestation (in-toto layout produced during build)
- [x] artifact signing and attestation with cosign
- [x] release manifest generation for downstream consumption
- [x] docs and verification steps
- [x] CI gating for release workflows

Testing & verification: CI run attached reproduces packaging and produces signed artifacts and manifests. Added an integration test (tests/release/test_manifest_verification.py) that downloads artifact, verifies signature with cosign public key from .well-known/cosign/pub.pem, checks SBOM fields and asserts provenance subject hashes match artifact digest. Manual verification steps are documented in PROVENANCE.md.

Rollout: This PR updates release automation only; no runtime code changes. The release pipeline will be updated to call new workflow on tag creation. Ops will be notified and provided the public cosign key in Vault.

Related: follows up on previous PRs adding signing support and CI targets (see PRs 3401, 3333). Linked Linear: ENG-2481 (release automation), ENG-2520 (supply-chain compliance).

Notes: using cosign key management via KMS-backed keys (GCP KMS) is documented; a follow-up will add HSM-backed key rotation flow for enterprise users.

release_notes:
- Add reproducible packaging and deterministic builds for private-installer artifacts.
- Generate SBOMs (SPDX + CycloneDX) for all release artifacts.
- Produce provenance attestations and sign artifacts with Cosign.
- Emit machine-readable release manifests consumed by upgrade/rollback tooling.
- Document verification steps in docs/release/PROVENANCE.md
